Metadata.title: Acme
Metadata.description: Write posts once, schedule them across platforms and see how they perform.

HomePage.title: Welcome to Acme
HomePage.description: Write posts once, schedule them across platforms and see how they perform.

ApiStatus.title: API status
ApiStatus.description: Whether this app can reach the Acme server.

detail.loading: Asking the server for its health…
detail.healthy: The server answered its health check.
detail.unreachable: The server did not answer. Check that it is running and that ACME_API_URL points at it.

NotFoundPage.title: Page not found
NotFoundPage.description: There is nothing at this address.

errors.EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED: Confirm your email address first, with the link we sent you.
errors.INVALID_EMAIL_OR_PASSWORD: The email or the password is incorrect.
errors.INVALID_TOKEN: This link is invalid or has expired.
errors.PASSWORD_TOO_SHORT: The password needs at least 12 characters.
errors.USER_ALREADY_EXISTS: An account already uses this email address.

SignInPage.title: Sign in
SignInPage.resent: We sent a new confirmation link to {email}.

SignUpPage.title: Create your account
SignUpPage.description: Write posts once, schedule them everywhere.
SignUpPage.sent: We sent a link to {email}. Open it to confirm your address: it signs you in.

VerifyEmailPage.title: Email confirmed
VerifyEmailPage.description: Your address is confirmed, and you are signed in.
VerifyEmailPage.invalidDescription: A confirmation link works once, for an hour. Enter your email to get a new one.
VerifyEmailPage.sent: If {email} has an account waiting for confirmation, a new link is on its way.

ForgotPasswordPage.title: Reset your password
ForgotPasswordPage.description: Enter your account's email, and we will send you a link to choose a new password.
ForgotPasswordPage.sent: If {email} has an account, a link to reset its password is on its way.

ResetPasswordPage.title: Choose a new password
ResetPasswordPage.description: Signing in again will need it. Every other session of your account is signed out.
ResetPasswordPage.done: Your password is changed. Sign in with the new one.
ResetPasswordPage.invalidDescription: A reset link works once, for an hour.

AppPage.title: Hello, {name}
AppPage.description: Your workspaces, and what you may do in each.
AppPage.empty: You do not belong to any workspace yet. Create one, or ask for an invitation.
AppPage.role: {role, select, owner {Owner} admin {Admin} editor {Editor} contributor {Contributor} viewer {Viewer} other {{role}}}
AppPage.createDescription: You will own it, and can invite people to it.

InvitationPage.title: Join a workspace
InvitationPage.description: Someone invited you to a workspace on Acme.
InvitationPage.signedOut: Sign in, or create an account with the address the invitation went to, then open the link again.
InvitationPage.failed: This invitation is no longer valid, or it is for another email address.

scopes.offlineAccess: Stay connected while you are away, until you disconnect it
scopes.workspaceRead: Read the workspace: posts, channels, media and analytics
scopes.workspaceWrite: Do what your role allows in the workspace, such as writing, scheduling and publishing posts

device.title: Connect the command line
device.description: Enter the code your terminal shows to let the Acme command line act as you.
device.signedOut: Sign in first, then enter the code your terminal shows.
device.codeHint: Eight letters and digits, such as WDJB-MJHT.
device.invalid: This code is wrong, or it expired. Run acme login again for a new one.
device.used: This code was already used. Run acme login again for a new one.
device.approved: Done. You can go back to your terminal.
device.denied: You denied the sign-in. Nothing was given access.

workspace.title: Pick a workspace
workspace.description: The application you are connecting acts in the one workspace you pick. To use it in another, connect it again.
workspace.empty: You do not belong to any workspace yet. Create one, then connect the application again.

consent.title: Allow {client} to use Acme?
consent.description: Check what it asks for before you answer.
consent.workspace: It will act as you in {workspace}, and will be able to:
consent.workspaceUnknown: It will act as you in the workspace you picked, and will be able to:
consent.redirect: Afterwards, you will go back to {host}.
consent.unverified: Acme has not checked this application. Allow it only if you trust it and started this connection yourself.
